description: Makes two workouts of one session into one, given both ids and versions: keep keeps its id and name and takes the other's exercises and what either measured (calories, heart rate, route), and the other is removed. For the same session logged twice, or a watch's copy of one you logged. Same day only. The person can undo it in one step in the app. Use it instead of deleting one of the pair: a watch's heart rate is only on its copy.
name: trainrec_merge_workouts
title: Merge two workouts
